entries.source: Humans are split into two categories: the Highers, and the rest. Highers have latent magic in their blood which gives them higher attributes and senses along with a longer life.
entries.target: 人类被分为两个亚种：高等人类和普通人类。高等人类的血脉中潜藏着魔力，使他们拥有更高的属性和更敏锐的感知，寿命也更长。

entries.source: A Human hailing from the northern town of Derth. A common kind of man, unremarkable in all respects.
entries.target: 一位来自北方小镇德斯的人类。一种随处可见的普通人，各方面都毫无特点。

entries.source: Grave strength, dread will, this flesh cannot stay still. Kings die, masters fall, we will outlast them all.
entries.target: 死亡的力量，恐惧的意志，这些肉体不会沉寂。国王去世，主人陨落，我们才是永生。

entries.source: Undead are humanoids (Humans, Elves, Dwarves, ...) that have been brought back to life by the corruption of dark magics.
entries.target: 不死族是被黑暗魔法复活的人形生物（人类，精灵，矮人…）。

entries.source: Undead can take many forms, from ghouls to vampires and liches.
entries.target: 不死族有多种形态，从食尸鬼、吸血鬼到巫妖。

entries.source: Slow to shuffle, quick to bite, learn from master, rule the night!
entries.target: 蹒跚而行，利齿如刀，师从主人，统治黑夜！

entries.source: Ghouls are dumb, but resilient, rotting undead creatures, making good fighters.
entries.target: 食尸鬼是愚钝但坚韧的腐烂不死生物，适合成为战士。

entries.source: They have access to #GOLD#special ghoul talents#WHITE# and a wide range of undead abilities:
entries.target: 他们能使用 #GOLD#特殊的食尸鬼技能#WHITE# 和种类繁多的不死系能力：

entries.source: - special ghoul talents: ghoulish leap, gnaw and retch
entries.target: - 特殊食尸鬼技能：食尸鬼跳跃、啃噬和腐秽呕吐

entries.source: The rotting bodies of ghouls also force them to act a bit more slowly than most creatures.
entries.target: 食尸鬼腐烂的身体同时使它比别的生物行动要慢一些。

entries.source: The marching bones, each step we rattle; but servants no more, we march to battle!
entries.target: 行进之骨，咯吱有声；奴役不再，出征迎战！

entries.source: Skeletons are animated bones, undead creatures both strong and dexterous.
entries.target: 骷髅由活化的骸骨构成，是强壮而敏捷的不死生物。

entries.source: They have access to #GOLD#special skeleton talents#WHITE# and a wide range of undead abilities:
entries.target: 它们天生具有#GOLD#特殊骷髅技能#WHITE#和一系列不死系能力：

entries.source: - special skeleton talents: bone armour, resilient bones, re-assemble
entries.target: - 特殊骷髅技能：骨质盔甲、坚韧骨骼、重组
